title: English reading formats gain direct citations and dated source context
summary: The 34 plain-English and compact drafts now link to their paired formats. All 104 inherited reader articles gain section navigation, descriptive links and direct original-source citations. Relevant later checks appear alongside the unchanged original text and evidence cutoff, explicitly as source context rather than whole-article approval.
evidence_note: The highlighted records are the Energy, Quantum and Water plain/compact pairs inspected during this presentation pass. Shared template changes cover 104 original reader records, including 34 English editions. Exact source-ID joins expose 52 already recorded check contexts across 37 articles; fourteen of those articles are English reading editions. These joins neither perform new source retrieval nor provide independent editorial, subject, language or accessibility review. The September 10 writing date, inherited September 1 evidence cutoff, historical contracts and translation holds remain unchanged.
publication_effect: Local source implementation only. Production checks are prepared for all 17 compact HTML/CSS budgets and exact evidence-receipt identities, including the separate Shuttle companion and complete update archive. They have not been run against the interrupted production output. Build/access repair approval, actual rendering, independent review, release and first-month acceptance remain pending.
